analogy.rationale: Calcineurin inhibitors act through immunophilins (FKBP1A/PPIA) to block NFAT dephosphorylation, but the nine cell lines are not immune cells and express little calcineurin/NFAT, so transcriptional responses should be weak; the closest analogs are other immunosuppressive or calcium/NFAT-linked classes, though none share a strong downstream program in these cells.
